contractMetadata.description: If the price of Bitcoin (BTC) is greater than or equal to the price specified in the title on October 3, 2026 at 8:45am ET, this market will resolve to Yes. Otherwise, it will resolve to No. If no eligible trade occurs during the contract window, this contract will resolve based on the most recent traded price prior. Outcome verified against the LS-LRRR-XBTUSD index. View the [full rules](https://assets.gemini.com/predictions/terms_and_conditions/btc_398860b3-ea2f-47a7-b167-a8c6ad03d6d7.pdf).

labels: RAW venue rows, preserved verbatim. Nothing here is a position, a P&L or a settlement; it is what the account record says about orders and their fill state.

verdict.why: a contract qualifies only when rows on BOTH outcomes carry a fill. Accepted-but-unfilled opposite-side orders do NOT qualify, which is exactly the distinction the question turns on.
